title: agaloma olivacea
intro: Agaloma olivacea, commonly known as the Olive Agaloma or Olive Yellow, is a plant species within the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in reducing stress and anxiety levels. The therapeutic actions of Agaloma olivacea are attributed to its ability to act as a nervine tonic, sedative, and anti-anxiety agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
